# LUCI Systems

> The Orchestration Engine for Enterprise Multimedia

LUCI Systems orchestrates every layer of technology running enterprise properties — AV, signage, building, and operational infrastructure — from a single interface.

## What LUCI is

- Multimedia orchestration platform + embedded operational partnership
- One interface across every endpoint, zone, and system on the property
- Software, hardware, operating model, and engineering team — one system

## Audiences

LUCI serves leadership, operations, technology, finance, marketing/guest experience, and facilities/AV teams at casinos, hotels, sports venues, airports, convention centers, and corporate campuses.
